catch_copy: Build your military camp, train up your troops, and put an end to the war.
description:
A CAMP LIKE NO OTHER
An evil maniac has conquered every territory in the region, except one. The world's last hope resides in an old military camp tucked away in this peaceful neck of the woods. Bring it back to its former glory to recruit and train a brave mob of fighters to push back the evil forces.

BUILD
Take on the challenge of building a military camp while keeping a sharp eye on your resources and logistics. Place your buildings efficiently, hire the staff needed to keep the wheels turning, and set up the training courses. Build up your defences, because the enemy will be sending spies and drones to try and sabotage your camp.

MANAGE
You won't just be managing your recruits' training and your budget, but also their rosters—because this military camp doesn't take a "smoko"! Look after the building maintenance and the well-being of your rookies — you don’t want them ending up in the wars! Adapt to different biomes and research hundreds of technologies and upgrades for your camp.

TRAIN AND SPECIALISE
Recruit the best candidates to join your forces. They might start out as green privates, but you’ll assign them a speciality based on their skills and turn them into elite specialists across a variety of classes. Who knows? Maybe the best of the bunch will end up teaching your future recruits…

MISSIONS
Put all those hours of hard yakka to work! Complete different missions to reclaim territory, snag resources, and win over the local populations. Balance your squad to make sure you can get the job done, as every mission requires a different set of specialisms.

CAMPAIGN AND SANDBOX
Play a campaign packed with absurd humour and nods to classic war films. As you go, you’ll rescue heroes who’ll give your camp a proper boost. Plus, you can play at your own pace in Sandbox mode, customising the game exactly how you like it by choosing the biome, challenges, and starting conditions. Your camp, your rules!

CUSTOMISE
Want to make your camp stand out from the pack? Customise the flags, signs, and the characters you recruit.
